verdict.rationale: Devin's cloud sessions run in isolated per-session VMs with their own shell/browser/repo access (devin-docs-13), and the CLI supports an explicit --sandbox flag enforcing OS-level isolation of writable paths and network access (devin-docs-12), which supports safely testing changes without touching a real production system. However, there's no explicit documentation of database/production-data isolation, staging environment provisioning, or data seeding for testing purposes specifically. Missing for 10: explicit production-data isolation/mocking guidance, staging-environment or test-data provisioning features, and independent verification that sandboxed runs never touch real prod resources.
